body: Owner-authorized broader audit completed in [restrictions provenance audit #85](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/issues/85). It records four native-reproduced implementation discrepancies (build1486–1489), two bounded original-side research tasks (#83/#84), historical task/test assumptions and checked owner-approved exceptions. No product code changed or original game launched. This supplements the four GUI research tasks78–81; it does not supersede their scope.
